Question: What is the loss ratio, number of claims, total loss by policy number and premium where total loss is the sum of loss payment, loss reserve, expense payment, expense reserve amount and loss ratio is total loss divided by premium?
Generated Query:
SELECT
    p.Policy_Number,
    p.Premium,
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.Claim_Identifier) AS Number_Of_Claims,
    COALESCE(SUM(lpmt.Amount), 0)
      + COALESCE(SUM(lrsv.Amount), 0)
      + COALESCE(SUM(epmt.Amount), 0)
      + COALESCE(SUM(ersv.Amount), 0) AS Total_Loss,
    (
        COALESCE(SUM(lpmt.Amount), 0)
      + COALESCE(SUM(lrsv.Amount), 0)
      + COALESCE(SUM(epmt.Amount), 0)
      + COALESCE(SUM(ersv.Amount), 0)
    ) / NULLIF(p.Premium, 0) AS Loss_Ratio
FROM Policy p
JOIN Claim c
    ON c.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Claim_Payment cp
    ON cp.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Loss_Payment lp
    ON lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier = cp.Claim_Amount_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Expense_Payment ep
    ON ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier = cp.Claim_Amount_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Claim_Reserve cr
    ON cr.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Loss_Reserve lr
    ON lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier = cr.Claim_Amount_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Expense_Reserve er
    ON er.Claim_Amount_Identifier = cr.Claim_Amount_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Claim_Amount lpmt
    ON lpmt.Claim_Amount_Identifier = lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Claim_Amount epmt
    ON epmt.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Claim_Amount lrsv
    ON lrsv.Claim_Amount_Identifier = lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Claim_Amount ersv
    ON ersv.Claim_Amount_Identifier = er.Claim_Amount_Identifier
GROUP BY
    p.Policy_Number,
    p.Premium;

What is the total loss of each claim by claim number where total loss is the sum of loss payment, loss reserve, expense payment, expense reserve amount?

    c.Claim_Number,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN cp.Payment_Amount ELSE 0 END), 0) +
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN cr.Reserve_Amount ELSE 0 END), 0) +
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN cp2.Payment_Amount ELSE 0 END), 0) +
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN er.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN cr2.Reserve_Amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS Total_Loss

LEFT JOIN Claim_Payment cp
    ON c.Claim_Identifier = cp.Claim_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Loss_Payment lp

LEFT JOIN Claim_Reserve cr
